propositions: The structured-output parser selects the first JSON object that parses syntactically rather than the first that validates against the target schema, causing it to extract dependency-link records quoted in verifier prose instead of the verdict object that follows.

When a parent ticket's children have interdependencies, show_ticket returns raw JSON including Dep records; the verifier's prose quotes those records before stating its verdict, and tolerant_parse returns the quoted Dep (first parseable) instead of the CompletionVerdict (valid under schema).

The selection policy is schema-blind by design (first-wins documented in _first_json_object to prevent draft/correction ambiguity), shared across all structured LLM gates (plan-review, ticket-digest, overlap-verifier, epic-bug-screen), and not correctable at the extractor layer alone without atomic coordination with the extraction directive.

A permanent fix requires multi-layer architecture: (1) schema-aware selection in parse_structured with key-overlap screening to prevent all-defaults contracts from accepting empty objects, (2) sentinel-delimited output channel (<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>> markers) replacing markdown-fence detection, (3) property-based tests encoding the invariant that any prose containing a schema-valid payload renders that payload recoverable, and (4) raw-reply artifact persistence on parse failure for post-hoc diagnosis.
